What's the actual mess — duplicate tickets, stale ones that should be closed, priority ordering, or missing triage on stuff that's been sitting untagged? I don't want to start reorganizing/closing things on my own read and have it turn out you meant something narrower.

If it helps, my default would be: sweep for dupes, close anything clearly stale/done, flag untriaged items for a confidence pass — nothing get deleted, just reordered/tagged. Say the word and I'll run that, or tell me what you actually meant.
